professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, and communicative domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging strength, such as social engagement and learning potential, and areas requiring targeted intervention, including fine motor coordination, attention and focus, communication skills, and behavioral regulation. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to address these areas of need and facilitate Sabrina's developmental progression. A collaborative, family-centered approach involving occupational therapy, speech therapy, and behavioral support services will be beneficial to address Sabrina's comprehensive developmental needs. Family involvement and educational support will be essential to maximize therapy outcomes. Regular monitoring and reassessment through follow-up evaluations will be important to track progress and adjust intervention strategies to ensure Sabrina achieves her functional independence and developmental milestones efficiently. This assessment provides a foundation for developing an individualized intervention plan tailored to Sabrina's unique needs and strengths.
